definitions.explanation: A persistent, heavy, throbbing pain that is not sharp. Common in medical contexts when describing symptoms.

examples.english: I have a dull pain in my lower back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鈍痛|どんつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: I've had a dull headache since this morning.

examples.japanese: {鈍痛|どんつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{何日|なんにち}→何日：23870_nannichi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{治|おさ}まらない→治まる：27790_osamaru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: If the dull pain doesn't subside for several days, you should go to the hospital.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {鈍|どん} (dull, blunt) and {痛|つう} (pain). Used to describe a heavy, lingering ache as opposed to a sharp pain. Common when describing symptoms to a doctor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鈍痛|どんつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have a dull pain)
- {鈍痛|どんつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (dull pain continues)
- {鈍痛|どんつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (a dull pain runs through)
- {鈍痛|どんつう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel a dull pain)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{激痛|げきつう}→激痛：17165_gekitsuu⟧: intense pain — sharp, severe pain, the opposite of {鈍痛|どんつう}
- ⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧: sharp pain — a stabbing or piercing sensation
